r3_buckets.desc: Capital nodes — highest economic loss per interruption (semiconductor fabs, data centers, refineries, hospitals)

r3_buckets.label: Industrial / Medium-Large Enterprise
r3_buckets.desc: Industrial belt — significant continuity requirements (manufacturing, logistics hubs)

r3_buckets.label: Commercial / SME-Dense
r3_buckets.desc: Service economy + retail — moderate individual impact (commercial districts, mixed-use)

r3_buckets.label: Light / Agricultural / Rural
r3_buckets.desc: Sparse activity, agricultural land — lower VoLL (residential, agricultural)
